lines.en: Grandma, come outside! Look at the sky!
So many stars tonight. How beautiful!
lines.ko: 오늘 밤 별이 정말 많아요. 참 아름다워요!

lines.en: Where is the moon? I can't see it.
It's behind that cloud. Wait a little.
lines.ko: 저 구름 뒤에 있어요. 조금 기다려요.

lines.en: Last night the sky was cloudy.
Yes, but the air is clear now.
Is the earth a planet too?
Yes. The earth is our home in space.
lines.ko: 네. 지구는 우주에 있는 우리 집이에요.

lines.en: Will you show me more stars tomorrow?
Sure. We will bring a warm blanket.
Grandma, why is the sun so big?
The sun is a big, hot star.
And is the moon a star too?
No. The moon goes around the earth.
This morning I saw the moon in the sky.
Really? Sometimes the moon comes out in the day.
How many planets are in space?
Eight planets go around the sun.
lines.ko: 여덟 개의 행성이 해 주위를 돌아요.

lines.en: I will read a book about space tonight.
lines.ko: 오늘 밤에 우주에 관한 책을 읽을 거예요.

lines.en: Good. Thank you for your good questions.
